title: Verification
intro: Statuses only. ID images and background reports stay with the providers; a proof of address opens with a logged reason.
finalDecisionFrom: A final decision can be made from {date}
requiredFor: {count, plural, one {Needed for # in-home category} other {Needed for # in-home categories}}
attempts: {count, plural, =0 {No tries yet} one {# try since the last reset} other {# tries since the last reset}}
nameDiffers: The name on the ID doesn't match the account's name.
redaction: Provider asked to delete the ID images on {date}

identityFailure.document_unreadable: Last try: the ID photo was unreadable.
identityFailure.selfie_mismatch: Last try: the selfie didn't match the ID.
identityFailure.under_18: Last try: the ID shows someone under 18.
identityFailure.other: Last try: the check couldn't be completed.

identityBlocked.too_many_attempts: 5 tries without a pass: waiting on staff.

identityRequested.staff_request: Staff asked for a new check.
identityRequested.name_changed: The legal name changed after the last check.

requestedRow: Staff asked for a new proof.
documentKept: Document stored (deleted 30 days after the decision).
readOnly: Trust and safety, support leads and admins make verification decisions.

autoCheck.title: Automatic reading
autoCheck.unreadable: The automatic reading couldn't read the document.
autoCheck.name: Name matches: {answer}

reveal.title: Open the proof of address
reveal.description: The address and document are restricted. Your name, the time and your reason go to the audit log.
reveal.reasonHint: Why you need to see it, for example: "Reviewing the proof sent on Nov 17."

decide.title: Review the proof of address
decide.description: Check that the name matches the account, the address matches what was entered, and the document is dated within 90 days. The helper sees the reason for a rejection, never your note.
decide.reasonRequired: Choose what the helper is told.
decide.noteHint: What you checked and why. At least 10 characters.

actions.request_address: Ask for a new proof of address
actions.request_identity: Ask for a new ID check

actionHints.request_address: The current verification stops counting, and offers pause until a new proof is approved.
actionHints.confirm_name: Confirm the ID belongs to this person (a nickname or a married name, for example). The ID check then counts.
actionHints.allow_identity_retry: The try count starts again (also after an under-18 result that was a misread).
actionHints.request_identity: The current ID check stops counting, and offers pause until a new one passes.
actionHints.engage_background: After reviewing the report at Checkr: in-home categories open for 12 months.
actionHints.pre_adverse_background: Checkr sends the notice with a copy of the report and the summary of rights. The final decision waits 7 days.
actionHints.post_adverse_background: Final: the helper can no longer take in-home categories. Checkr sends the notice.

queues.title: Verifications
queues.intro: Proofs of address to review, ID checks waiting on staff, and background checks to adjudicate, oldest first.
queues.readOnly: You can see the queues; trust and safety, support leads and admins decide.
queues.label: Verification queues

empty.identity: No ID checks waiting on staff.

queues.autoAllMatch: Automatic reading: name, address and date match.

identityKinds.name_check: The ID's name differs from the account's

queues.toReview: Came back "consider": review the report at Checkr

previews.sectionBackground: Person: background check after the notice
